name: The Last Dinner
summary: Marianna Grey is laying the Green Queen's last supper in the inn yard, and each guest has a last request.

stages.journal: Marianna is feeding the village in the inn yard while the inn's cellar lasts. Every guest at the long table has a last request.
The long table ate in peace. Everyone who asked got something, and Marianna wept into the gravy.
The supper went cold. The table was empty by the time the song started.
